Messages.Author: Gerry
Messages.Body:
I have a few quistions after meeting a new playgroup here in Sweden.

1. Is telepatic tracking playable after a combat ends card is played? (like
majesty)

2.When exectly do you gain control of a vampire with corruption?

3. Must a vampire with Lunatic eruption attack before your other minions
actions?

4.Can you chose when in the minionphase you take control over a mindraped
vampire?

Most people in the playgroup argues that an action that is 'forced' must be
performed at first possible opportunity, is there a rule to that effect?

Thanks in advance.

Gerry

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <3a2721c0$1...@news.sto.telegate.se>,

"Gerry" <gkl...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> I have a few quistions after meeting a new playgroup here in Sweden.
>
> 1. Is telepatic tracking playable after a combat ends card is played?
> (like majesty)

Yes.

> 2.When exectly do you gain control of a vampire with corruption?

When you successfully play the corruption card that matches
their capacity. You can only burn the counters to take
control of them when you are doing the action, so you have to
do it when you place the last corruption counter on them.

> 3. Must a vampire with Lunatic eruption attack before your
> other minions actions?

Except hunting, yes.
See LSJ quote at bottom of message.

> 4.Can you chose when in the minion phase you take control over a
> mindraped vampire?

Not really, no.
You must do it during the minion phase by Sabbat War card text,
so you have to do it before other things.

> Most people in the playgroup argues that an action that is 'forced'
> must be performed at first possible opportunity, is there a rule to
> that effect?

LSJ already answered this in another thread.
http://www.deja.com/getdoc.xp?AN=698219373

"Mandatory actions are to be taken before others.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) VTES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to revised rulebook, rulings, errata, and tournament rules:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/"

Carpe Noctem.

Lasombra

http://lasombra.tripod.com
http://legbiter.tripod.com
http://vekn_clans.tripod.com

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Lasombra wrote:

> "Gerry" <gkl...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> > 4.Can you chose when in the minion phase you take control over a
> > mindraped vampire?
>
> Not really, no.
> You must do it during the minion phase by Sabbat War card text,
> so you have to do it before other things.

Actually, yes. It's not an action, so it doesn't have to be done before
other actions. It's just something you have to do during your minion
phase.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.

GP...@videotron.ca wrote:

Hi.

> I seem to be confused by the people that answers the questions around
> here. Who's right, and who's wrong?

Anyone and everyone.

> Who is eligible to answer properly, besides LSJ???

> Except for "Oh Mighty LSJ", who else can answer correctly?

Anyone is eligible to answer correctly, but the
only one whose opinion you really need to hear
is L. Scott Johnson. He is the official VTES
net rep for White Wolf, was the official VTES
net rep for Wizards of the Coast, is the head
of the Rules Team, and is the design lead for
VTES with White Wolf.

If you want a well thought out answer that will
be passionately defended to the death, try
James Coupe or Noal McDonald. They will most
often be right. Not always, but most often.
They have both been here for years and
understand the game very well.

If you want a rules quote, with a link to
the previous ruling and or to the place
in the rules where your question is answered,
try Lasombra. I won't be answering unless I
can show you where in the rules or the online
rulings the answer is, so I will be right quite
often as well.

If you want a good answer that makes sense,
but may or may not be supported by the current
rules, I will recommend Gomi no Sensei and Xian.
They have both put a lot of thought and effort
into the game, but have not spent as much time
on the nagging details of the rules.

> More than a week ago, i asked a question about Lunatic Eruption and
